{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-5","id":"msg_011CdeCfhQH5bWvW6uG1nLfB","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"I found and fixed the bug — it was in `src/parser/collectSheetRules.ts`, the \"crude CSS parser\" that builds the selector→declaration map from `<style>` elements. Two separate bugs there compounded to break the example:\n\n**Bug 1 — loop-variable collision silently drops all but the first `<style>` block.** The outer loop over `<style>` elements and the inner loop over `property: value` pairs both reused the same `let i, len` declared once at the top of the function. After the inner loop for the first style block ran, `i` and `len` were left at the inner loop's final values (e.g. `i=1, len=1`), so the outer loop's own `i < len` check then evaluated to `1 < 1` and immediately stopped — any style elements after the first were never parsed at all. That's exactly why in the sample doc `.red { fill: red; }` (declared in the *second* `<style>` tag) was ignored, and the second circle fell back to the default black fill instead of red.\n\n**Bug 2 — naive `split(':')` truncates values containing a colon.** Declarations were parsed with `pair.split(':')` and taking `pair[0]`/`pair[1]`, which breaks for any value that itself contains a colon — e.g. `fill: url(https://example.com/paint.svg#swatch)` — leaving `fill` set to the truncated `url(https` instead of the full URL.\n\nFix applied:\n- Scoped the outer loop's counter to `for (let i = ...)` so it can no longer be clobbered by inner logic.\n- Renamed the inner loop's counters (`j`/`jLen`) and switched from `split(':')` to splitting only on the *first* colon (via `indexOf`), so multi-colon values like paint-server URLs are preserved intact.\n\nI verified the fix against the exact document from the prompt plus two additional cases (multi-class shapes, and a `fill: url(...)` value) via a scratch test, then added a permanent regression spec at `src/parser/collectSheetRules.spec.ts` covering all three. The full existing parser test suite (`src/parser/**`) still passes; the only failures in the broader suite are pre-existing font-metric snapshot mismatches in `Text` specs, unrelated to this change (confirmed by reproducing them on unmodified `master`)."}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":165,"cache_read_input_tokens":76120,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":165,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0},"output_tokens":1,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global"},"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"3afc5f31-3691-4902-b1d2-6eb13863b1af","uuid":"3935d9a0-9a82-4b61-aef5-2f4622f31632","timestamp":"2026-08-02T16:01:37.066Z"}
